title: The mollified functional F(f) = u(φ ∗ 1_B f) is linear and L¹(B)-bounded (Step 3 of Simon 2.34)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝⁿ and u : (ℝⁿ → ℝ) → ℝ; call a : ℝⁿ → ℝ admissible if a is C^∞, has compact support and spt a ⊆ U (spt g denotes the closed support of g, the closure of {g ≠ 0}; Lean: tsupport g). Assume (L1) u(a + b) = u(a) + u(b) for admissible a, b; (L2) u(c·a) = c·u(a) for c ∈ ℝ and admissible a; (C) whenever K ⊆ U is compact, a_k (k ∈ ℕ) and b are C^∞ functions ℝⁿ → ℝ with spt a_k ⊆ K for all k and spt b ⊆ K, and D^q a_k → D^q b uniformly on ℝⁿ for every q ∈ ℕ, then u(a_k) → u(b). Let x₀ ∈ ℝⁿ, ρ > 0 and ε > 0 with B̄_{ρ+ε}(x₀) ⊆ U, and put B := B_ρ(x₀). Let φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C^∞ with compact support and spt φ ⊆ B̄_ε(0), such that (Bd) for every q ∈ ℕ there is C_q ∈ ℝ with ‖D^q(φ ∗ g)(x)‖ ≤ C_q ∫|g| dLⁿ for every Lⁿ-integrable g : ℝⁿ → ℝ and every x ∈ ℝⁿ. Here (φ ∗ g)(x) = ∫ φ(t) g(x − t) dLⁿ(t) (Lean: convolution φ g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) and D^q is the q-th Fréchet derivative. For f : ℝⁿ → ℝ put F(f) := u(φ ∗ (1_B f)), where 1_B f is f on B and 0 off B. Then F(f + g) = F(f) + F(g) and F(c·f) = c·F(f) for all f, g integrable on B and c ∈ ℝ, and there is C ∈ ℝ with |F(f)| ≤ C ∫_B |f| dLⁿ for every f integrable on B.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl n)) (u : (Eucl n → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ a b : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → u (a + b) = u a + u b) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (a : Eucl n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → u (c • a) = c * u a) → (∀ (a : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ) (b : Eucl n → ℝ) (K : Set (Eucl n)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (a k)) → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b → (∀ k, tsupport (a k) ⊆ K) → tsupport b ⊆ K → (∀ q : ℕ, TendstoUniformly (fun k x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q (a k) x) (fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ q b x) atTop) → Tendsto (fun k => u (a k)) atTop (𝓝 (u b))) → ∀ (x₀ : Eucl n) (ρ ε : ℝ), 0 < ρ → 0 < ε → closedBall x₀ (ρ + ε) ⊆ U → ∀ φ : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ closedBall 0 ε → (∀ q : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, Integrable g volume → ∀ x : Eucl n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ q (convolution φ g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x‖ ≤ C * ∫ y, |g y| ∂volume) → (∀ f g : Eucl n → ℝ, IntegrableOn f (ball x₀ ρ) volume → IntegrableOn g (ball x₀ ρ) volume → u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator (f + g)) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) = u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator f) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) + u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator g) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume)) ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : Eucl n → ℝ), IntegrableOn f (ball x₀ ρ) volume → u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator (c • f)) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) = c * u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator f) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume)) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : Eucl n → ℝ, IntegrableOn f (ball x₀ ρ) volume → |u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator f) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume)| ≤ C * ∫ x in ball x₀ ρ, |f x| ∂volume
